section.name: Feedback
section.p: Feedback on any aspect of Scope is welcome. Offers of help on any aspect of Scope is even more welcome! I'm Steve Meyfroidt, based in London. My email address is: smeyfroi@users.sourceforge.net
You can use also the Yahoo User's group, where you can post messages and read the archives of previous discussions.
And report any bugs in the bugtracker here
